files.html: //! examples/audio_keyboard - a playable keyboard: seventeen keys, from middle C to the E an octave and a third above, //! played with the computer keyboard or the pointer, sounded by the mixer's instrument (`z.mixer.sine_instrument`). //! //! The computer keyboard is laid out as music programs lay it out: the middle row is the white keys, the row above it //! the black keys between them. //! //! W E T Y U O P //! A S D F G H J K L ; //! C D E F G A B C D E //! //! A key's note goes to the instrument as a note event (`Mixer.sendNote`) - a key down starts it, a key up releases //! it - and the renderer starts it at its next block. The events are read at the app's frame here; the latency plan //! moves them off the frame path. In a page, the browser keeps the sound silent until the first click or key press. const std = @import("std"); const Allocator = std.mem.Allocator; const indexOfScalar = std.mem.indexOfScalar; const z = @import("zimr"); const zm = @import("zm"); const Color = zm.Color; const Vec2 = zm.Vec2; const float = zm.float; const atkinson_mono_ttf = @embedFile("atkinson_mono_ttf"); const background: Color = .{ .r = 24, .g = 26, .b = 34, .a = 255 }; const text_color: Color = .{ .r = 230, .g = 230, .b = 235, .a = 255 }; const white_key_color: Color = .{ .r = 236, .g = 236, .b = 240, .a = 255 }; const black_key_color: Color = .{ .r = 30, .g = 30, .b = 36, .a = 255 }; const held_key_color: Color = .{ .r = 255, .g = 170, .b = 60, .a = 255 }; const key_outline_color: Color = .{ .r = 90, .g = 94, .b = 110, .a = 255 }; /// The lowest note: MIDI key 60, middle C. const lowest_key: u8 = 60; /// The computer keys that play the notes, one semitone each from `lowest_key` up. const note_keys = [_]z.KeyboardKey{ .a, .w, .s, .e, .d, .f, .t, .g, .y, .h, .u, .j, .k, .o, .l, .p, .semicolon }; const note_count: usize = note_keys.len; /// Whether each semitone of an octave, from C, is a black key: C# D# F# G# A#. const is_black_in_octave = [12]bool{ false, true, false, true, false, false, true, false, true, false, true, false }; /// Where a note's key is drawn: black or white, and the white key it sits on or to the right of. const KeyPlace = struct { is_black: bool, white_index: usize, }; /// Each note's place on the drawn keyboard: a white key takes the next white place; a black key sits over the gap to /// the right of the white key before it. fn keyPlaces() [note_count]KeyPlace { var places: [note_count]KeyPlace = undefined; var white_count: usize = 0; for (&places, 0..) |*place, note_index| { const is_black: bool = is_black_in_octave[note_index % 12]; if (is_black) { place.* = .{ .is_black = true, .white_index = white_count - 1 }; } else { place.* = .{ .is_black = false, .white_index = white_count }; white_count += 1; } } return places; } const key_places: [note_count]KeyPlace = keyPlaces(); const white_key_count: usize = 10; const State = struct { font: z.Font, /// Which notes the computer keyboard holds down. held_by_keyboard: [note_count]bool, /// The note the pointer holds down, while it does. held_by_pointer: ?usize, /// Whether presses and releases arrive through `onInput` (`AppSpec.on_input`): set at its first call. Until then /// - and in a launcher that does not call it - each frame reads the computer keyboard instead. is_input_from_events: bool, notes_started: u32, }; fn initState(gpa: Allocator, f: *z.Frame, s: *State) !void { const font: z.Font = try z.loadFont(f, gpa, atkinson_mono_ttf, 16); s.* = .{ .font = font, .held_by_keyboard = @splat(false), .held_by_pointer = null, .is_input_from_events = false, .notes_started = 0, }; z.audio_device.init(f.audio_device); // The page's sound diagnostics, at its top: the path that plays, and the renderer's own reports. z.audio_device.showDiagnostics(f.audio_device); f.mixer.setInstrument(z.mixer.sine_instrument); } fn deinit(gpa: Allocator, s: *State) void { z.unloadFont(gpa, s.font); } /// Sends a note's key going down or up to the instrument. fn sendNote( f: *z.Frame, s: *State, note_index: usize, is_down: bool, pressed_at_ms: f64, ) void { const key: u8 = lowest_key + @as(u8, @intCast(note_index)); // The press's own time, when there is one, so that the readout measures the note's lag from the press. const note: z.mixer.NoteEvent = .{ .key = key, .is_down = is_down, .velocity = 0.5, .pressed_at_ms = pressed_at_ms, }; const is_sent: bool = f.mixer.sendNote(note); if (is_sent and is_down) { s.notes_started += 1; } } /// The keyboard's rectangle in the window: the window's width less a margin, and a third of its height. const Layout = struct { left: f32, top: f32, white_width: f32, white_height: f32, fn ofWindow(f: *z.Frame) Layout { const margin: f32 = 24; const keyboard_width: f32 = f.window.widthf() - 2 * margin; const white_width: f32 = keyboard_width / float(white_key_count); return .{ .left = margin, .top = 96, .white_width = white_width, .white_height = white_width * 3.5 }; } fn keyRect(layout: Layout, note_index: usize) z.Rectangle { const place: KeyPlace = key_places[note_index]; const white_left: f32 = layout.left + float(place.white_index) * layout.white_width; if (!place.is_black) { return .{ .x = white_left, .y = layout.top, .width = layout.white_width, .height = layout.white_height }; } const black_width: f32 = layout.white_width * 0.6; const black_left: f32 = white_left + layout.white_width - black_width / 2; return .{ .x = black_left, .y = layout.top, .width = black_width, .height = layout.white_height * 0.62 }; } }; fn isInside(point: Vec2, rect: z.Rectangle) bool { const is_inside_x: bool = point[0] >= rect.x and point[0] < rect.x + rect.width; const is_inside_y: bool = point[1] >= rect.y and point[1] < rect.y + rect.height; return is_inside_x and is_inside_y; } /// The note under the pointer: a black key first, since it is drawn over the white ones. fn noteUnderPointer(layout: Layout, pointer: Vec2) ?usize { for (0..note_count) |note_index| { if (key_places[note_index].is_black and isInside(pointer, layout.keyRect(note_index))) { return note_index; } } for (0..note_count) |note_index| { if (!key_places[note_index].is_black and isInside(pointer, layout.keyRect(note_index))) { return note_index; } } return null; } /// The computer keyboard, read each frame while presses do not arrive as events (`is_input_from_events`): a key /// pressed this frame starts its note; a key held until now and no longer down releases it. fn readComputerKeyboard(f: *z.Frame, s: *State) void { for (note_keys, 0..) |note_key, note_index| { if (z.isKeyPressed(f.input, note_key)) { s.held_by_keyboard[note_index] = true; sendNote(f, s, note_index, true, z.getKeyPressTime(f.input, note_key)); } else if (s.held_by_keyboard[note_index] and !z.isKeyDown(f.input, note_key)) { s.held_by_keyboard[note_index] = false; sendNote(f, s, note_index, false, 0); } } } /// The pointer: pressed on a key, it starts the key's note; moved onto another key while down, it releases the first /// and starts the second, as a finger sliding along a keyboard; let go, it releases its note. fn readPointer(f: *z.Frame, s: *State, layout: Layout) void { const pointer: Vec2 = z.getMousePosition(f.input); const is_down: bool = z.isMouseButtonDown(f.input, .left); const note_now: ?usize = if (is_down) noteUnderPointer(layout, pointer) else null; if (note_now == s.held_by_pointer) { return; } if (s.held_by_pointer) |released_note| { sendNote(f, s, released_note, false, 0); } if (note_now) |started_note| { // A note started by the press itself carries its time; one a finger slides onto has no press behind it. const is_new_press: bool = z.isMouseButtonPressed(f.input, .left); const pressed_at_ms: f64 = if (is_new_press) z.getLastPressTime(f.input) else 0; sendNote(f, s, started_note, true, pressed_at_ms); } s.held_by_pointer = note_now; } /// The note `key` plays, or null for a key that plays none. fn noteOfKey(key: z.KeyboardKey) ?usize { return indexOfScalar(z.KeyboardKey, &note_keys, key); } /// A press or release, the moment it arrives (`AppSpec.on_input`): a note key's press starts its note and its release /// ends it, and the pointer's press or release does the same for the key under it - the sound asked for now, not at /// the next frame. The pointer gliding onto another key while held is read each frame (`readPointer`). fn onInput(f: *z.Frame, s: *State, event: z.InputEvent) void { s.is_input_from_events = true; switch (event) { .key_down => |down| { const note_index: usize = noteOfKey(down.key) orelse return; if (down.repeat or s.held_by_keyboard[note_index]) { return; } s.held_by_keyboard[note_index] = true; sendNote(f, s, note_index, true, z.getKeyPressTime(f.input, down.key)); }, .key_up => |up| { const note_index: usize = noteOfKey(up.key) orelse return; if (!s.held_by_keyboard[note_index]) { return; } s.held_by_keyboard[note_index] = false; sendNote(f, s, note_index, false, 0); }, .mouse_button_down, .mouse_button_up, .touch_begin, .touch_end => readPointer(f, s, .ofWindow(f)), else => {}, } } fn drawKey(f: *z.Frame, s: *State, layout: Layout, note_index: usize) void { const is_held: bool = s.held_by_keyboard[note_index] or s.held_by_pointer == note_index; const resting_color: Color = if (key_places[note_index].is_black) black_key_color else white_key_color; const fill: Color = if (is_held) held_key_color else resting_color; const rect: z.Rectangle = layout.keyRect(note_index); f.gl.rect(rect, .{ .color = fill }); f.gl.rect(rect, .{ .color = key_outline_color, .outline = 1.0 }); } /// The latency readout: the output that plays, then the last five starts the mixer measured, newest first - the wait /// for the renderer, the sound queued ahead of the note, what lies past the output, and their sum /// (`z.mixer.Mixer.formatLatencyLine`). Its lines start at `top`. fn drawLatencyReadout(f: *z.Frame, s: *State, top: f32) void { f.gl.textf( .{ 24, top }, "output: {s}", .{f.mixer.outputName()}, .{ .size = 15, .color = text_color, .font = &s.font }, ); const readout_header: []const u8 = z.mixer.Mixer.latency_readout_header; f.gl.text(.{ 24, top + 22 }, readout_header, .{ .size = 15, .color = text_color, .font = &s.font }); var recent: [z.mixer.recent_start_capacity]z.mixer.LatencySample = undefined; const measured: []z.mixer.LatencySample = f.mixer.recentStarts(&recent); const past_output_ms: f64 = f.mixer.outputLatencyMilliseconds(); const shown_count: usize = @min(measured.len, 5); for (measured[0..shown_count], 0..) |latency_sample, line_index| { var line_buffer: [96]u8 = undefined; const line: []const u8 = z.mixer.Mixer.formatLatencyLine(latency_sample, past_output_ms, &line_buffer); const line_top: f32 = top + 44 + float(line_index) * 22; f.gl.text(.{ 24, line_top }, line, .{ .size = 15, .color = text_color, .font = &s.font }); } } fn draw(f: *z.Frame, s: *State, layout: Layout) void { z.clearViewport(f, background); const instructions: []const u8 = "A S D F G H J K L ; and W E T Y U O P, or the pointer, play the keys"; f.gl.text(.{ 24, 24 }, instructions, .{ .size = 18, .color = text_color, .font = &s.font }); f.gl.textf( .{ 24, 56 }, "notes played {d}", .{s.notes_started}, .{ .size = 16, .color = text_color, .font = &s.font }, ); // White keys first, then the black ones over them. for (0..note_count) |note_index| { if (!key_places[note_index].is_black) { drawKey(f, s, layout, note_index); } } for (0..note_count) |note_index| { if (key_places[note_index].is_black) { drawKey(f, s, layout, note_index); } } drawLatencyReadout(f, s, layout.top + layout.white_height + 24); } fn update(f: *z.Frame, s: *State) void { // A black screen with a start button, until it is pressed and the audio runs (`z.showAudioStartScreen`). if (z.showAudioStartScreen(f, &s.font)) { return; } const layout: Layout = .ofWindow(f); if (!s.is_input_from_events) { readComputerKeyboard(f, s); } readPointer(f, s, layout); draw(f, s, layout); } pub const app: z.AppSpec(State) = .{ .config = .{ .window = .{ .title = "zimr - keyboard", .width = 760, .height = 520, .scale_mode = .responsive, }, }, .init = initState, .memory = .managed, .deinit = deinit, .update = update, .on_input = onInput, };
